title: Leading layout / Live sport
slide_intent: Pair a clear viewing instruction with energetic imagery so excitement does not hide when and where to watch.
strategic_value: A stable upper-left identity and schedule can make Channel 4 sport promotions useful as well as recognizable.
demonstration: A cropped racing poster places the green 4 beside Stream or watch live and Next Saturday 2pm, above oversized pink lettering.
practical_value: Compare the small functional information with the high-energy image and headline.

content_islands.name: Viewing information
content_islands.spec: Keep the logo and two-line live-viewing instruction at the upper left.

content_islands.name: Racing image and headline
content_islands.spec: Use the racing car as the field behind widely spaced large lettering.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity and viewing time are applied to a racing promotion.
